title: Signed speed limits per road class, measured from OSM
description: What the speed table stands on. On every class below motorway the open-road limit is essentially the national 90 km/h; what separates a national road from a communal one is how much of its length runs inside a locality at 50. That share is measured here, length-weighted, so the travel-time model assumes physics rather than speeds.

localityThresholdKmh.description: At or below this signed limit a segment is taken to be inside a locality. Romanian law sets 50 in built-up areas (OUG 195/2002 art. 49).

classes.description: One entry per OSM highway class.

coverage.description: Share of this class's length carrying a numeric maxspeed tag.

usable.description: False when coverage is too thin for the class to be read on its own.

locality_share.description: Share of tagged length signed at or below the locality threshold.
